item: N1-N3 - packaging, signing and updates: prerequisites
verdict: PARTIALLY PROVEN - update server half of N2 done; the rest blocked
honestyNote: No signing, installer or update-server work was performed or claimed. This records what is present and what is missing, measured on this machine.

missing.note: This one needs no credentials — only a toolchain install (cargo install tauri-cli, or adding @tauri-apps/cli as a devDependency plus the bundler downloads). Adding a build dependency to the project is the owner’s decision, not a step to take unasked in order to make a test pass.

placeholdersN1AsksToReplace.note: These are exactly the placeholders N1 names. Replacing them requires a real signing key. Obtaining, installing or handling the owner’s signing key is a credential operation I will not perform — and an unsigned build presented as signed would be the most damaging possible false green in this whole programme, because downstream everything trusts a signature.

whatCouldBeDoneWithoutCredentials: Build an UNSIGNED Windows Tauri bundle and confirm it is produced (does not satisfy N1, and only partially informs N2)
Everything else in N depends on credentials or a macOS/CI host
ownerActionToUnblock: Provide a code-signing certificate or a cloud signing service (Azure Trusted Signing, DigiCert KeyLocker, SSL.com eSigner) — preferably cloud-based, so the key is never handled locally
Provide Apple Developer credentials and enable macOS CI for notarization
gh auth login, to reach cloud macOS CI and a clean CI machine for N3
Provide Cloudflare credentials for the update server deployment

progressSinceFirstProbe.N2 update server: PROVEN without credentials. A real HTTP server on loopback serves a real signed manifest at the exact Tauri endpoint shape, a real request returns it, and the client verifies it with real Ed25519 over the artifact SHA-256. The manifest hash is checked against the bytes actually downloaded. All seven refusal paths hold by name: tampered artifact, wrong key, malformed signature, unsigned manifest, hashless manifest, downgrade, and below the upgrade floor. See release/OCADE_N2_UPDATE_SERVER.json.
progressSinceFirstProbe.why that was possible: src/lib/packaging/update-signature.ts makes the distinction explicit: a release certificate identifies the PUBLISHER, which is separate from whether the signing and verification pipeline works. The pipeline is provable today with a generated key pair; the certificate is not.

stillBlocked.N1 Windows signing: zero code-signing certificates in the store
stillBlocked.N1 macOS sign + notarize: no Apple Developer credentials, no macOS host
stillBlocked.N2 installers: Tauri CLI + bundler not installed (no credentials needed — owner decision)
stillBlocked.N2 deployed update server: no Cloudflare credentials; the manifest logic itself is proven above
stillBlocked.N3: no freshly provisioned clean CI machine (gh unauthenticated)
